question: Anai Mudi and Doda Betta, two of the highest peaks in the Western Ghats, are located in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu and Kerala**__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anai Mudi** is the highest peak in the **Western Ghats** and also the highest point in **South India**, standing at an elevation of **2,695 meters**. It is located in the **Idukki district** of **Kerala**.
 
• The name **Anai Mudi** literally translates to 'elephant's forehead', and the peak is situated at the junction of the **Cardamom Hills**, the **Anaimalai Hills**, and the **Palani Hills**.
 
• **Doda Betta** is the highest point in the **Nilgiri Mountains** with an altitude of **2,637 meters** and is situated in the **Nilgiris district** of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It lies at the intersection of the **Western Ghats** and the **Eastern Ghats**, providing a unique ecological corridor and a panoramic view of the **Coimbatore plains**.
 
• Both peaks are critical components of the **Western Ghats**, which is one of the world's eight 'hottest hotspots' of **biological diversity** and a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.

 **Additional Information__**

 
• **Western Ghats (Sahyadri)**:
 
 
• Stretches approximately **1,600 kilometers** along the western coast of India through the states of **Gujarat**, **Maharashtra**, **Goa**, **Karnataka**, **Kerala**, and **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• Characterized by **Shola forests**, which are patches of stunted tropical montane forest separated by rolling grasslands.
 
• Home to endemic species such as the **Nilgiri Tahr** and the **Lion-tailed Macaque**.
 
• Major rivers like the **Godavari**, **Krishna**, and **Kaveri** originate from these highlands.
 
 
 
• **Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve**:
 
 
• The first biosphere reserve in India established in **1986**, encompassing parts of **Wayanad**, **Nagarhole**, **Bandipur**, **Mudumalai**, **Nilambur**, and **Siruvani**.
